title: Three levels by design (an example)
about: A plainer scheme, invented for this example: weak, fair or strong. Randomised evidence starts strong, a natural experiment fair, observational evidence weak; imprecision, inconsistency and risk of bias each lower it a step, and nothing raises it. It shows that the scheme is a declaration: the same studies stand differently under another.
text:
scheme three_levels
levels weak fair strong
start randomised strong
start quasi_experimental fair
start observational weak
down risk_of_bias 1
down inconsistency 1
down imprecision 1
